subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The technical vocabulary and foreign words make this text a little more ______.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Difficult**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The word "**difficult**" accurately describes the text with technical vocabulary and foreign words.
 
• It means that the text is not easy to understand or comprehend. (समझाना आसान नहीं है)
 
 
• **Example**: "*The scientific research paper was difficult to read due to the complex terminology used.*"
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Futile **means pointless or ineffective. (निरर्थक या अप्रभावी)
 
• **Stagnant **means not moving or changing. (हिलना या बदलना नहीं)
 
• **Feasible **means possible or achievable. (संभव या प्राप्य)

1e4:T89c,
The correct answer is: **Simple**.
